web_events.query: China PMI economic data this week
web_events.answer: China's producer price index (PPI) in May surged 3.9% year-on-year, marking the fastest growth in nearly four years, driven by rising raw material costs from the Iran war and an AI investment boom. Meanwhile, consumer price index (CPI) rose 1.2% year-on-year, missing economists' estimates of 1.3% growth.
